description: A/B test: generate images for 5 writing briefs using references/styles/ presets (with_skill) vs. free-form prompt engineering from SKILL.md general guidance only (without_skill). Judge style consistency, composition fit, and text legibility.

styles.brief: Generate a header illustration for an article titled 'How I Use AI to Co-Write Essays'. The image should show a human writer and a small friendly robot collaborating at a desk, with notes, timeline, and storyboard panels. Style: hand-drawn pencil sketch with light watercolor washes, clean white background, muted pastel accents.

Generate a header illustration for a literary essay titled 'The Future of Reading'. Use a visual metaphor: a paper boat sailing across an ocean of open book pages toward a lighthouse. Style: contemporary editorial illustration, layered composition, restrained palette, no text.

Generate an architecture diagram for a blog post explaining 'Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)'. Show user query, knowledge base, and generated answer flow. Style: clean isometric technical diagram, modern SaaS palette, white background. Include a bold headline 'How RAG Works'.

Generate a knowledge poster for a social media explainer titled '5 Sleep Myths Debunked'. Show 5 numbered cards with icons and short labels. Style: clean knowledge poster, navy background, white text, mobile-friendly vertical layout.

Generate a 4-panel storyboard sequence for a short film pitch: an astronaut repairs a spacecraft, a meteor shower appears, the astronaut dodges debris, the astronaut reaches the airlock. Style: cinematic storyboard, consistent character, no text.
